caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: A two-line team-motivation promise makes three operative phrases into large separate lavender rough-display tags.
visual_anatomy.layout: A ten-row comparison table uses stacked cylinder slices as the strategy index on the left, then aligns each row to breakdown, risk-to-watch, and cost columns.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Headline and scope sentence → headers → scan each numbered strategy row left-to-right from proposed action through warning and cost.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large light sans headline, rough display emphasis, bold column headings, and compact multiline table copy.
visual_anatomy.colour: Lavender structures the strategy column, pink the breakdown column, aqua the caution column, and pale blue the cost column.
visual_anatomy.surface: White ground, thin dark tabular rules, shallow 3D cylinder slices, flat header fields, and a restrained grey shadow beneath the table.
visual_anatomy.modules: Ten repeated strategy rows crossed with three decision-support columns and a cost value.
visual_anatomy.density: Very high: the viewer gets a long-option shortlist, implementation note, caution, and price range in one scan surface.

motion.observed_state_change: The complete table is visible in early and intermediate samples. The near-complete sample shows a broad horizontal shear or crop passing through rows and headings before the source returns to the stable table; no new strategy-to-risk relationship is introduced by the observed motion.
motion.motion_job: Add motion energy to a dense reference while leaving the static table responsible for the actual comparison.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Compare many possible interventions without losing the downside or resource commitment attached to each one.
transferable_mechanism.argument_shape: Option table with implementation, risk, and cost columns.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Give every option the same decision-relevant fields and use visual depth only to make the primary option index easy to locate.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when cost ranges, risks, and intervention descriptions are all defensible and consistently scoped; motion should not conceal a table the reader needs time to inspect.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the team-posting tactics, ten-row roster, cost claims, cylinder-index treatment, four-column layout, rough title tags, pastel headers, or non-semantic distortion motion.

claim_boundary.note: The visible strategy efficacy, cost ranges, and warnings are creator assertions and cannot be used as benchmark evidence without independent support.
